difficulty_component_associations.bootstrap: Deterministic percentile bootstrap resampling complete contracts.

components.definition: Mean of robust-normalized metadata-stripped bytecode bytes and opcode count.
components.label: Bytecode scale

components.definition: Mean of robust-normalized cyclomatic proxy, block-count proxy, and control-flow opcode count.
components.label: Control flow

components.definition: Mean of robust-normalized signature count, source declaration count, and nonblank source lines.
components.label: Interface/source

components.definition: Mean of robust-normalized storage operations, external calls, create operations, and log operations.
components.label: State interaction

components.definition: Weighted indicators for inline assembly, delegatecall, fallback, receive, create2, and selfdestruct.
components.label: Low-level Solidity

difficulty_component_associations.interpretation: Descriptive associations with across-model mean cumulative success outcomes; not adjusted, causal, or independent component importance.
difficulty_component_associations.label: Descriptive difficulty-component associations
difficulty_component_associations.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg correction jointly across the five components and four primary outcomes (20 tests).
difficulty_component_associations.outcome_aggregation: Arithmetic mean of each cumulative outcome across all model rows for the same contract.

outcome_definitions.abi_exact_cumulative: One when ABI evaluation has no false-positive or false-negative signatures; zero when recovery is inexact or a prerequisite fails.
outcome_definitions.abi_f1_cumulative: Per-contract ABI F1 from the evaluator, with zero assigned when format or compilation failure prevents ABI evaluation.
outcome_definitions.compile_pass: One when the final artifact after repair compiles; zero otherwise.
outcome_definitions.format_pass: One when the original decompilation output passes the output format protocol; zero otherwise. Repair is downstream and cannot erase an original format success.
outcome_definitions.semantic_perfect_cumulative: One when the contract has at least one ABI function, ABI recovery has no false positives or false negatives, and every ground-truth ABI function passes all semantic cases; zero otherwise.
outcome_definitions.semantic_rate_cumulative: Number of ground-truth public-function signatures that pass every stored semantic case divided by all benchmark semantic entries for the contract, including fallback and receive entries; missing or ineligible entries contribute zero.

specification.formula: outcome ~ difficulty_score_z + log1p(prompt_char_length)_z + log1p(n_public_functions)_z + model fixed effects
specification.inference: contract-clustered sandwich standard errors and deterministic contract-cluster percentile bootstrap
